The previous form took values[n] from a list that had already dropped every null OR ZERO year, so for a company whose revenue fell to zero it compared two historical non-zero years and served the result as current growth - EXR reported +450.7% where the exact comparison gives -100%.
The contract now: a missing fiscal year gives NULL; a zero BASE gives NULL (undefined, not "no history"); a zero LATEST gives -1.0, i.e. -100%, because a value that fell to nothing did not go missing.
